sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October, looking to bounce back from their most recent loss. Sandbach sit top with 22 points from 10 games and have won seven matches overall, so despite the recent setback they remain well-placed. They then travel to Cheadle Heath Nomads on Saturday 10 October in their second fixture of the week.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town (20 points) face Dawley Town away on Saturday 3 October as they chase the leaders, while third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth visit Eccleshall in a mid-table encounter. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth on 19 points, host Wednesfield Community on Saturday 3 before playing Stafford away on Saturday 10. The bottom of the table remains dire: Widnes Town (2 points) visit Brereton Social, Alsager Town (4 points) host Sandbach before facing Shawbury United away, and Telford Town (6 points) travel to Cheadle Heath Nomads. Brereton Social then host Wednesfield Community midweek on Wednesday 7 October before facing Allscott Heath away on Saturday 10. Bilston Town (17 points, in-form with recent wins) host Crewe on Saturday 10, while Barnton entertain struggling Dawley Town the same day. Market Drayton Town take on New Mills at home on Saturday 3 and host Widnes on Saturday 10, while New Mills visit Telford Town on Saturday 10. Shawbury United (10 points, on a six-game losing run) travel to Sandbach on Saturday 3 before hosting improving Alsager Town on Saturday 10. Allscott Heath host Crewe on Saturday 10 after their midweek fixture, and Foley Meir visit Bilston Town on Saturday 3.
